# AI Discovery Guide

The Awtsmoos lets an agent begin with human meaning, acquire exhaustive route/project evidence, and only then make source-level claims.

## Navigation order

1. `llms.txt` for compact routing.
2. `docs/README.md` or `/docs/` for the human map.
3. `docs/LEARN/` when concepts/workflow are unfamiliar.
4. nearest project/system/API-family manual.
5. `docs/AI/MANIFEST.json` for enriched project discovery.
6. `docs/AI/API_TUTORIALS/MANIFEST.json` for API-route discovery.
7. `docs/GENERATED/` for exhaustive evidence.
8. current source/callers/tests/runtime for final authority.

## Project records

`docs/AI/PROJECTS/` contains one bounded project packet per current boundary. Project records connect exact path/type/family to entries, human docs, generated project tutorial, file shape, symbol summary, incoming/outgoing lexical project dependencies, external package evidence, public HTML entries, and documentation coverage.

Use `/docs/?view=projects` for the same evidence interactively.

Project packets answer repository/system-shape questions. They do not prove runtime reachability, deployment health, authorization, behavioral test coverage, or complete dynamic dependency graphs.

## API tutorial records

Every generated route has a bounded AI record under `docs/AI/API_TUTORIALS/ROUTES/`. Route packets answer URL/source/method/vessel/caller/test questions and remain distinct from project ownership packets.

## Public `/docs/` discovery

The public manifest declares bounded search, project, API-tutorial, page and content shards. `/docs/?view=learn` exposes learning tracks; `/docs/?view=api` exposes route evidence; `/docs/?view=projects` exposes project evidence.

## Evidence rules

- API unknown method is never GET.
- Route method/status/header evidence is lexical unless source proves more.
- Project imports are lexical edges, not runtime call graphs.
- External package evidence excludes malformed dynamic strings and Node built-ins.
- Public project entries mean HTML entry files were discovered, not that apps are healthy.
- Test-file counts are evidence, not quality scores.
- Caller matches are discovery evidence, not dispatch proof.
- A syntax-failed derech weakens runtime confidence even if strings were extracted.
- Public publication excludes planning/thought, dependency/build/vendor and private-user roots.
- Environment docs expose names, not secret values.
- When docs conflict with current source/tests, source/tests win and docs should be updated/regenerated.

## Commands

```sh
node scripts/docs/generate-docs.js
node scripts/docs/project-evidence-test.js
node scripts/docs/tutorial-engine-test.js
node scripts/docs/search-engine-test.mjs
node scripts/docs/validate-docs.js
```
